scope: Issue #121 named source; bounded single-source extraction, not a literature search

use_case_changes.note: Links are added to the use_case records by the integrator after review (records -- change). Proposed evidence-gap text is in report.md of the ML-versus-baseline pass, not in the store.

gaps: No per-method accuracy value is printed in a table or the text; P-R AUC, TPR and PPV at maximum F1 and leaderboard rankings are only in Figures 1b, 2a, 4a, 4c, 4d and Additional file 2 Figures S3, S5, S8 and S9.

Additional file 1 Tables S1, S2 and S4 hold per-fusion predictions. Computing accuracy from them would need the paper's lenient paralog scoring, minimum-evidence thresholds and wisdom-of-crowds truth sets, which the text does not state precisely enough for a derivation.
The FusionBenchmarking repository holds code and inputs, not result tables; runtime_analysis/all_progs_cancer/runtimes.txt holds per-sample run times behind Figure 4b and was not used.
deFuse has no method record in the store; its Table 1 row (AdaBoost classifier) is not recorded as a claim.
